title: Piri Reis map showing Antarctica

tellings.quote: It's like the map of Piri Race where you have the sort of uh tropical parts of Antarctica that are shown uh you know at the top.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, drawing on the writer Graham Hancock, points to the Piri Reis map, a map dated 1513, and to a similar one called the Oronteus Finaeus map. Michels says the Piri Reis map seems to show parts of Antarctica as tropical, near the top of the map. The story is told because, if true, it would mean someone mapped Antarctica long before anyone is thought to have seen it, when it was not covered in ice.
